items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: No but I don't know if Miley Barnes knew him now.

ctx.x: Well maybe Albert Jones or you know, or Dede. That's all in that same neighborhood.
Dede must not be able to be in touch with him on the corner because he can't see so good you know. Oh no. No but I don't know if Miley Barnes knew him now.
Well I'll find him. Your brother Sam, did he play saxophone much at all?
